title: UG-004 — How to configure free text quiz questions
intent: Explain how scoring works for free text questions in a quiz.
short_answer: For a free text quiz question, define the correct answers and the points awarded. You can award the same number of points for the whole question, or assign points answer by answer.
important_conditions: Use “equal to” when a specific text should receive points.
Use “empty” when no entered text should receive points.
Use “all other values” only when points are configured for each answer.
